(3) A spoon scoops the pink mousse from the glass. The background is a brightly lit outdoor patio with green plants. (4) The camera shows a table with a variety of green matcha-themed desserts, including dango skewers in bear-shaped glasses and croissants with green cream. (5) A metal spoon digs into a green matcha pudding, and a piping bag extrudes green cream onto a croissant. (6) Matcha sauce is poured over a slice of matcha cheesecake with a red fruit filling. (7) Two glasses with bear faces are filled with green matcha latte. (8) The camera pans across a large indoor dining area with a checkered black-and-white floor, ornate chandeliers, and hanging greenery. (9) The final shot shows the exterior of a white building with 'DAISY VILLA' written on it, surrounded by lush green trees and potted plants under bright daylight.
